name: f8_grab_crossday_fixed_cosine_routing_v1
session_rule: For each provider, fit a separate source-day, same-user SessionSignature in source StandardScaler coordinates. From the four class-matched calibration trials take the mean of the four cosine-agreement entries, map (mean+1)/2, clip to [0.05,1], multiply the fixed 0.5 population weight and renormalize.
score_rule: Compare fixed uniform fusion with fixed F8 routing on identical native held-out trials; macro-F1, log loss, Brier and minimum-user macro-F1. Day 3 never selects a rule.
scope: Retrospective public cross-day diagnostic using previously inspected subjects and days. Source classifiers are refitted only to replay frozen parent probabilities. No target labels or evaluation windows fit a state, and no new model selection or own-device claim is made.
